description: Page through covered laptop and Chromebook models — browse or enumerate only. Use get_coverage instead to test whether a brand, model, or part type is covered at all. Use get_model_parts instead for one model's parts. Use resolve_request or search_parts instead to find a model from free text. Ordered by reliability tier (green = verified on the OEM site, then yellow, then red), then slug A to Z. brand and category combine with AND when both are given. Follow next_cursor (null on the last page); pages are stable for the same data_revision; total is the full filtered count.

brand.description: Optional manufacturer, exact name but case-insensitive, e.g. "Lenovo", "Dell", "HP" (see get_coverage brands).

cursor.description: Optional. The next_cursor value from the previous page, e.g. "20"; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Optional page size, 1 to 100; default 20, or 100 when brand or category is given.

name: list_models

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

title: List laptop models
